## Projects & Open Source

- [AIScanAuto](https://aiscanauto.com): AI car diagnostics combining OBD-II data with plain-language explanations. Platform availability and downloads on the product website.
- [EchoLang](https://echolang.io): Offline AI voice translator for iPhone — on-device Whisper speech recognition and TranslateGemma translation via MLX. 33 languages, no cloud, no accounts, fully private.
- [fastapi-viewsets](https://github.com/svalench/fastapi_viewsets): DRF-style ViewSets for FastAPI — auto-generates CRUD endpoints from SQLAlchemy, Tortoise or Peewee models.
- [django-graph-search](https://github.com/svalench/django_graph_search): Production-ready semantic vector search for Django — traverses FK/M2M relations, RAG-ready, zero migrations.
- [llm-cache-router](https://github.com/svalench/llm-cache-router): Semantic caching + multi-provider LLM routing with cost tracking — a lightweight production library.
- [testcaseer](https://github.com/svalench/testcaseer): CLI tool that transforms browser actions into ready-to-use test cases. Stop writing them by hand.
- [pgadmin-ai-gateway](https://github.com/svalench/pgadmin-ai-gateway): Secure AI-agent connector for pgAdmin with RBAC roles, audit logging and an MCP-compatible interface for PostgreSQL.
- [pythonSiemens](https://github.com/svalench/pythonSiemens): Industrial tooling from the factory floor: Python ↔ Siemens PLC communication (OPC UA / S7), data logging and vision pipelines.
